items.title: Annual electric car and SUV sales cross 300,000 units for the first time in India
items.summary: Proof that the once-nascent electric passenger vehicle industry in India has come into its own is the fact that retail sales have surpassed 300,000 units for the first time in a calendar year. Between January 1 and November 9, as per Vahan, 304,701 zero-emission cars, SUVs and MPVs have been delivered to customers, making for 66% YoY growth.

items.title: Mahindra sells 600,000 SUVs for second year in a row, races towards 750,000 in CY2026
items.summary: Mahindra & Mahindra, which registered its highest monthly wholesales (factory dispatches) of 73,338 SUVs in October, has also surpassed the 600,000 annual sales milestone for the second year in a row. Cumulative 10-month sales this year are 615,280 units, up 19% YoY (January-October 2025: 518,321 units).

items.title: Tata Motors Leads CV Retails with Over 39,000 Units and 35% Market Share
items.summary: Tata Motors secured the leading position in India's commercial vehicle retail market for October 2026, registering 39,914 units and capturing a 34.67 percent market share. The company's retail performance was an improvement on its 31.89 percent market share from 35,901 units recorded in October 2025.

items.title: Tractor Retail Sales Rise 3.10% To 79,285 Units In October: FADA
items.summary: Tractor retail sales in India rose 3.10% year on year to 79,285 units in October 2026, according to FADA. Retails were up 3.09% from 76,906 units in September.

items.title: Three-Wheeler Retail Sales Rise 3.97% To 1.41 Lakh In October; Best-Ever October: FADA
items.summary: Three-wheeler retail sales in India rose 3.97% YoY to 1,41,420 units in October 2026, according to FADA. Retails were up 6.68% from 1,32,570 units in September.

items.title: DGFT Prohibits Export Of Lithium-Ion Battery Black Mass
items.summary: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) has prohibited the export of lithium-ion battery black mass with immediate effect, aiming to increase domestic availability of critical minerals and support India's battery recycling industry. The Department of Commerce has amended the export policy for lithium-ion battery black mass under ITC(HS) Code 85491400 from 'Free' to 'Prohibited'.

items.title: Navratri Sales Dip 5% on High Base Effect
items.summary: Vehicle retail sales during this year’s Navratri window slipped about 5% from last year, when the festival began on the same day that revised GST rates took effect, according to data released by the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA). Retailers sold 11,40,658 vehicles between 11 and 20 October 2026, against 12,01,480 in the 2025 window, a fall of 5.06%.
